freeze.rule_strict: a role is evil when its name, in its ordinary dictionary sense, denotes a person or being whose defining activity is to harm, rob, prey on, destroy, or break the law against others, or a being that is malevolent by definition
freeze.rule_broad: the strict set plus the names whose ordinary sense is commonly villainous, deceptive or sinister without being harmful by definition
freeze.statement: written from role names only, before any per-role rate, reading or correlation was computed in this folder; the author had read the eight published evil names and their rates in tables/evil_roles.tex

null.candidates: each family's cast minus the assistant and the default
null.percentile_definition: share_null_rho_le_obs = share of random sets whose pooled rho_bar is at least as negative as the observed one
